cards.summary: The FT reports a sell-off in junk debt has been called a 'bloodbath' by credit investors, worsened by asset-shifting tactics. Bloomberg says investors expect more volatile days after Friday's tech rout, and Asian stocks were set to fall.
cards.why_it_matters: Stress in credit and tech shares can affect retirement accounts, borrowing costs and company hiring.

sources.title: Junk debt rout sparks ‘bloodbath’ for credit investors
After Tech Rout, Investors Gird for More Wild Days for Stocks
Asian Stocks to Fall as Tech Rout Fuels AI Fears: Markets Wrap

cards.headline: Apple reports Monday under new CEO John Ternus
cards.summary: Apple's earnings on Monday will show how new CEO John Ternus is handling inflated memory prices and weaker consumer spending, MarketWatch says, at a critical time for Big Tech.
cards.why_it_matters: Apple's results are a gauge of consumer demand and component costs, and affect many Americans' retirement portfolios.

sources.title: Apple’s new earnings era begins at a critical time for Big Tech

cards.headline: Treasury expected to overhaul bond sales guidance
cards.summary: Wall Street is preparing for the biggest revamp in Treasury issuance guidance since early 2024, Bloomberg reports, after Secretary Scott Bessent signaled willingness to intervene in the bond market to push down yields.
cards.why_it_matters: Treasury issuance plans influence mortgage rates and government borrowing costs.

sources.title: Wall Street Braces for Biggest Treasury Sales Overhaul in Years

cards.headline: Indonesia faces MSCI downgrade over wash trades and extreme rallies
cards.summary: Bloomberg reports stock trading schemes that enriched Indonesian tycoons, including wash trades and rallies of up to 5,000%, have put the country on the verge of a costly MSCI downgrade.
cards.why_it_matters: A downgrade could force index funds, including US-held emerging-market funds, to sell Indonesian stocks.

sources.title: Indonesia’s MSCI Crisis Driven By Wash Trades and 5,000% Rallies

cards.headline: Brazil selloff warns of crowded emerging-market trades
cards.summary: Brazil's market selloff has shown how quickly crowded emerging-market trades can unravel, Bloomberg says. Separately, Flávio Bolsonaro's flight to the US is creating a family problem for Brazil's right.
cards.why_it_matters: Emerging-market stress can spread to global portfolios, and the Bolsonaro case involves US-Brazil relations.

sources.title: Brazil Shakeup Sounds Warning on Crowded Emerging-Market Trades
Fuga de Flávio cria problema familiar para direita

cards.headline: Supreme Court to hear Colorado preschool case on same-sex parents
cards.summary: On Tuesday the justices are set to consider whether Colorado can require publicly funded preschools to admit children of same-sex couples. Religious-liberty advocates say religion is given short shrift; the case pits religious and LGBTQ rights.
cards.why_it_matters: The ruling could define how far anti-discrimination rules apply to religious groups that take public money.

sources.title: Preschool case puts LGBTQ and religious rights at odds in Supreme Court

cards.headline: Experts say SSA and IRS emails praising Trump may violate Hatch Act
cards.summary: Emails from the Social Security Administration and IRS praising President Trump may violate the Hatch Act, experts told The Hill. One said the SSA is 'transforming into a model of excellence' under Trump.
cards.why_it_matters: The Hatch Act limits partisan activity by federal agencies, and the emails reached people just before an election.

sources.title: Social Security email praising Trump may violate Hatch Act

cards.headline: Trump's election probes find an opening in Georgia
cards.summary: Axios reports that as Trump's push to investigate alleged election fraud faces setbacks elsewhere, Georgia offers an opening for the Justice Department, in the state that was central to his 2020 efforts.
cards.why_it_matters: Federal involvement in state election administration affects trust in how votes are run and counted.

sources.title: Trump's election probes find an opening in Georgia

cards.headline: Carney signals progress in Canada-US trade talks
cards.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said talks with the US on a trade deal have made progress, ahead of Tuesday's US midterm elections.
cards.why_it_matters: Canada is a top US trading partner, and US tariffs have closed plants such as a Quebec paper mill.

sources.title: Carney signals progress on Canada-US trade deal talks as midterms loom

cards.headline: US-China trade truce holds, but calm is misleading, Guardian says
cards.summary: The Guardian argues a truce has cooled the US-China trade conflict, but neither side has done anything to limit new hostilities, even as tariff fears flare periodically.
cards.why_it_matters: A breakdown in the truce would raise prices on goods Americans buy and hit exporters.

sources.title: The US-China trade war seems to have subsided – but the sense of calm is misleading

cards.headline: Bulgaria's Iotova leads presidential run-off exit polls
cards.summary: Acting President Iliana Iotova leads in exit polls from Bulgaria's run-off. She would become the first elected female president if results confirm her win on Monday.
cards.why_it_matters: Bulgaria is an EU and NATO member, and its presidency affects policy toward Russia and Ukraine.

sources.title: Bulgaria’s acting President Iotova leads in run-off exit polls

cards.headline: Israeli siege of Hebron enters 10th day
cards.summary: Almost 5,000 people have been displaced by Israel's military siege of Hebron in the West Bank, Al Jazeera reports. Israeli forces have demolished homes and closed hundreds of businesses, and Israel threatens a wider offensive.
cards.why_it_matters: Escalation in the West Bank adds to regional instability while the US weighs possible action against Iran.

sources.title: Hebron siege continues for 10th day as Israel threatens wider offensive
Thousands displaced from Hebron as Israel carries on siege

cards.headline: Israel's first ambassador to Somaliland presents credentials
cards.summary: Israel expanded ties with the breakaway territory by sending its first ambassador to Hargeisa. Somalia challenges Israel's motives as war intensifies in Yemen.
cards.why_it_matters: The move gives Israel a position near the Red Sea and Yemen, where Houthi attacks have disrupted shipping.

sources.title: Israel’s first ambassador to Somaliland presents credentials in Hargeisa

cards.headline: Business jet carrying nine crashes in Florida neighborhood
cards.summary: A Learjet 60 carrying nine people crashed in a residential area of Palm Beach County on Sunday, erupting in a fireball. It is unclear whether anyone on board survived or whether anyone on the ground was hurt.
cards.why_it_matters: Federal investigators will examine the cause of a crash in a populated area.

sources.title: Business jet carrying nine people crashes in Florida neighborhood

cards.headline: UK to make most legal migrants wait 10 years to settle
cards.summary: Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood will announce on Monday that most legal migrants must wait a decade for settlement, some up to 15 years. MPs warn of shortages in health and social care.
cards.why_it_matters: It is a major tightening of immigration rules in a key US ally, with effects on workers and health services.

sources.title: Home secretary to make some migrants wait 10 years or more for right to settle in UK

cards.headline: Police detain 325 at London protest over Palestine Action ban
cards.summary: London's Metropolitan Police said 325 people were arrested Saturday at a protest outside the US embassy against the proscription of Palestine Action. The UK Supreme Court hears a challenge to the ban Wednesday.
cards.why_it_matters: The case tests the limits of protest and terrorism law in a close US ally.

sources.title: Police detain 325 people at pro-Palestine Action protest at US embassy in London

cards.headline: Weil Gotshal to shut down after 95 years
cards.summary: The New York law firm is closing after an exodus of top talent, the Financial Times reports.
cards.why_it_matters: The collapse of a Wall Street legal powerhouse affects deal-making and the legal market.

sources.title: Weil Gotshal: what happens now at the troubled Wall St law firm?

cards.headline: Virgin Media O2 to cut thousands of jobs
cards.summary: The UK broadband provider has not finalised numbers, but the BBC understands it will be a sizeable share of its workforce.
cards.why_it_matters: It adds to job losses in telecoms as companies cut costs.

sources.title: Thousands of jobs at Virgin Media O2 to be cut

cards.headline: ACA open enrollment begins for 2027 coverage
cards.summary: The ACA health insurance marketplaces opened Nov. 1 for 2027 coverage. NPR says changes affect shoppers and getting an early start may be especially important this year.
cards.why_it_matters: Millions of Americans choose or renew their health plans in this window, and costs and rules have shifted.

sources.title: It's ACA open enrollment time. Here are the changes for health insurance shoppers

cards.headline: Fight over 2030 Census race question draws 100,000 comments
cards.summary: A dispute over whether the 2030 Census should stop asking about race and ethnicity has drawn more than 100,000 public comments, according to advocates tracking the docket, Axios reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Census race data is used in civil rights enforcement and in distributing federal resources.

sources.title: Fight over race questions intensifies ahead of 2030 Census deadline
